{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Cleopatra Gas Gathering System''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/~/media/Enb/Documents/Factsheets/FS_Offshore_Pipelines_FINAL.pdf|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001610466/000161046617000014/a201610k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Holstein spar, Green Canyon to Ship Shoal facility.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001610466/000161046617000014/a201610k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Enbridge Inc<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/~/media/Enb/Documents/Factsheets/FS_Offshore_Pipelines_FINAL.pdf|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''500 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/~/media/Enb/Documents/Factsheets/FS_Offshore_Pipelines_FINAL.pdf|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''110 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/~/media/Enb/Documents/Factsheets/FS_Offshore_Pipelines_FINAL.pdf|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001610466/000161046617000014/a201610k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''20 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/~/media/Enb/Documents/Factsheets/FS_Offshore_Pipelines_FINAL.pdf|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.enbridge.com/~/media/Enb/Documents/Factsheets/FS_Offshore_Pipelines_FINAL.pdf|title=enbridge.com|website=enbridge.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001610466/000161046617000014/a201610k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
